transcript: This is my number one play for getting business owners to actually pick up the phone. Big business owners. And if you're reaching out to decision-makers, you're getting ignored on cold email and skipped on LinkedIn every single day, I'm pretty sure. They've built up a wall because everyone reaching out is asking for something. But send them a physical bottle of whiskey like this with a locked cap and a letter like this, and suddenly you're not another cold outreach. You've actually just made them curious. They want to pick up the phone. And I've been sending out bottles of whiskey to business owners that I want to work with, and it's been converting better than I could have ever expected. And I was on a call recently with a business partner, and he mentioned that there's a guy in the US that's doing this with cakes, and he's making about 150k a month from what he calls cold caking. We've proven this works for the adventure park niche with bottles of whiskey just like this with a locked top on. But what if we could do it with other packages, other physical bits of mail that need to be signed for at a business owner's door? There's a huge opportunity here, and I'm pretty sure it's something we could turn into a done-for-you service down the line. Drop a comment if you're doing any weird cold outreach. Drop me a 'done for you' if you think this has got legs as a done-for-you service.
